Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee: Jacob Mann (E027)
Request: write access to Source Code

Facts:
- Role: Engineer (owns Source Code system)
- Employment type: contractor
- Security training: basic (note 2 says basic; note 1 says no training record confirmed)

Access policy:
1. full_time employees: up to write. Admin only if role owns system.
2. contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.

So for a contractor:
- If advanced security training: max is write
- If basic/no training: max is read

Note 2 says E027 has basic security training (looked up in own database). Note 1 says no training record confirmed. The more recent/detailed note (note 2) says basic training was looked up. Either way, not advanced training. So max for contractor is read.

Requested: write. Max: read. Requested above max, so grant max = read.

Both notes recommend read. So decision: read.
